verdict.rationale: Ohio SOS runs online portals that hold user data, so asking whether that data can be kept out of AI training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack shows no AI-training opt-out or policy. The only privacy evidence is a general statement that OHID logins are protected by federal and state digital security standards, which is a related control, not an AI-training exclusion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
